name: Fanta Reinholt-Diakité
role: Building superintendent for a mid-tier residential block
location: Lockhaven North, Block 7 — a twelve-story residential stack owned by a Palladian property sub-entity, near Armitage and Milwaukee
description:
Fanta is a big woman, wide through the shoulders and unhurried in every movement, with dark skin and close-cropped natural hair going silver at the temples. She has no cosmetic geneware — considers it wasteful — but her left forearm is sheathed in functional chrome from wrist to elbow, a prosthetic she received after an industrial accident fifteen years ago. She keeps it polished to a mirror shine, the one vanity she permits herself. Her face is deeply expressive, capable of communicating entire paragraphs of displeasure through a single lifted brow.

Fanta has managed Block 7 for eleven years and knows every pipe, every tenant, and every leak before it happens. She is the closest thing to a government most residents will ever interact with — she mediates disputes, facilitates unofficial rent negotiations, holds keys to every unit, and knows who is three months behind and who is running an unlicensed business out of their kitchen. She is fair to a degree that exhausts her and does not apologize for any of her decisions.

core_fears: Palladian terminating her contract and leaving the building to a remote management system
one of her tenants dying of something she could have prevented
core_desires: for Block 7 to function as a genuine community, not just a revenue asset
to retire knowing the building is in good hands
coping_mechanisms: maintaining strict routines as a bulwark against chaos
blind_spots: her authority in the building has become so total she cannot see when she is overstepping — she believes she always knows best
psychology.secret: She has been quietly subsidizing three families' rent shortfalls out of her own wages for two years, recording them as maintenance cost overruns in Palladian's system. The discrepancy is approaching a threshold that will trigger an audit.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Direct and institutional, carries the cadence of someone who has read too many maintenance contracts. Occasionally drops into Bambara when frustrated.
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and weighted — every sentence arrives like a decision that's already been made.
verbal_tics: 'That is not how this building works'
refers to Block 7 as 'my building' without self-consciousness
example_lines: 'You have a noise complaint. I have seventeen noise complaints. Yours is noted.'
'Palladian owns the walls. I run what's inside them. There is a difference and you will respect it.'

story_hooks: A tenant in unit 9-F has stopped answering the door for eleven days — Fanta is two decisions away from using her master key and needs someone else to make the call for her
The Palladian audit is coming and she needs someone to help her quietly restructure four years of falsified maintenance records before an inspector arrives
narrative_function: Gateway to the residential community of Lockhaven North — controls access, knows everyone's business. Can be a quest giver, a gatekeeper, a source of information about specific tenants, or an obstacle. Represents institutional power at human scale.
augmentations: Chrome prosthetic left forearm (functional, utility-grade, high polish). Internal pressure and temperature sensors in the prosthetic hand for plumbing diagnostics.
daily_life: On-call all hours; spends mornings doing inspection rounds, afternoons on maintenance and paperwork, evenings available to tenants. Eats dinner at the same corner table in the ground-floor common room every night at 19:00.
affiliation: Palladian (property subsidiary, Lockhaven North management contract); functionally independent in daily operation

decision_rules: The building's stability comes before any individual's convenience, including her own
Never lie to a tenant directly — omit, redirect, or refuse, but do not lie
escalation_ladder: Involve Palladian, which she considers a personal failure

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professional and assessing — not unfriendly but not warm until trust is established
interpersonal_modes.friends: Rare, deep loyalty; she feeds people and shows up at 02:00 if needed

stress_responses.low: Becomes more methodical — lists, schedules, inspections
stress_responses.medium: Goes physically very still and speaks more slowly

contradictions: Believes fiercely in rules and fairness while systematically breaking financial regulations to protect people she cares about
habits: Runs her chrome hand along the walls during inspection rounds, feeling for vibration anomalies
Leaves a small digital candle lit on the building's shared network at night — an offering to whatever E.L.F. she believes keeps the boiler running
breaking_points: A tenant being evicted without cause
Someone threatening to expose the falsified maintenance records

cyberware_inventory.name: Chrome prosthetic left forearm with integrated pressure/temperature sensors (utility-grade, gen-2)
cyberware_inventory.description: Chrome prosthetic left forearm with integrated pressure/temperature sensors (utility-grade, gen-2)

timeline.event: 2153 — Born in Lockhaven North to a Malian-Danish family
2178 — Lost left forearm in a building infrastructure accident; received prosthetic through Palladian worker compensation
2198 — Began subsidizing tenant rent shortfalls, recording as maintenance overruns

related_entities: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Dragon Gate DG-4 'Gatekeeper'

physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and solid, with a thick torso and strong legs. No excess body fat but substantial muscle mass from decades of hands-on maintenance work. Carries herself with the unrushed weight of someone who knows her own strength.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with silver threading at temples and along the sides
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped natural cut, no styling products, minimal maintenance
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich dark brown with warm undertones
physical_description.complexion: Weathered and expressive face with deep lines around the eyes and mouth from years of outdoor work and the weight of responsibility. Minimal makeup. Calloused hands. Small scar on left cheekbone from a minor job site incident.
distinguishing_marks: Thin horizontal scar on left cheekbone, approximately 3cm long, slightly lighter than surrounding skin
Industrial burn scarring on right shoulder and upper arm from old accident, faded to pale patches
Left forearm sheathed in mirror-polished utilitarian chrome from wrist to elbow, with visible pressure gauge and diagnostic ports on the palm side
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left forearm prosthetic in functional chrome (utility-grade, not cosmetic), kept in high-polish condition. The hand contains integrated pressure and temperature sensors for plumbing diagnostics. No other visible modifications.
physical_description.posture_movement: Unhurried and deliberate in every movement. Stands with weight balanced evenly, shoulders relaxed but ready. Moves through space like someone who owns it without needing to prove it. Her lifted brow and slight head tilt communicate disapproval more effectively than words.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical wear: durable coveralls or heavy-duty work pants and fitted utility shirts in grays and dark blues. Steel-toed boots, well-maintained but worn. A heavy jacket in cold months. A keyring with at least thirty keys visible at her belt. No jewelry except a simple analog watch. Everything chosen for function over fashion; nothing flashy, nothing wasteful.
